metadata.title: World Digest — November 11, 2026
metadata.summary: Wall Street near-recovered as Nvidia sank 5.47%, while Russia and Ukraine agreed a large prisoner exchange without peace progress.

sections.title: Major Events
sections.content:
Russia, Ukraine Agree Large Prisoner Exchange as Talks Stall

Russia and Ukraine agreed to a major prisoner exchange, but talks in Abu Dhabi ended without a breakthrough on broader peace terms. AP News

Jim Jordan Wins House Leadership, Dogged by Abuse Controversy

Jim Jordan won the House minority leader race, but his election drew immediate backlash from Ohio State abuse survivors over his past conduct. Fox News

Israel’s New Parliament Sworn In as Eisenkot Moves to Reverse Netanyahu

Israel’s parliament convened as opposition leader Eisenkot pushed bills for an Oct. 7 inquiry and to undo the judicial overhaul, challenging Netanyahu. NBC News

US Measles Elimination Status at Risk Amid Vaccine Opposition

The U.S. could lose its measles elimination status as outbreaks surge, a public health setback linked to declining vaccination rates. The Guardian

Two Students Killed in Fiery Train Crash Near Chicago

Two elementary school students died when an Amtrak train struck their SUV in Western Springs, Illinois, halting Metra BNSF service. NBC 5 Chicago

sections.title: Political News
sections.content: The U.S. House voted along party lines to block impeaching Defense Secretary Pete Hegseth, amid Democratic absences and apologies USA Today. Indonesia's Vice President Gibran Rakabuming Raka resigned, destabilizing the ruling coalition BBC. Imprisoned ex-PM Imran Khan returned to a Pakistani jail after medical treatment Reuters. Russia and Ukraine agreed to a large prisoner exchange, though talks yielded no breakthrough AP News. Israel's new parliament convened as opposition leader Eisenkot unveiled plans to reverse Netanyahu policies NBC News. An appeals court ruled Kari Lake illegally fired VOA's director azcentral.com and The Arizona Republic.

sections.title: Financial News
sections.content:
Markets Rally on AI Rebound, Rate Fears Persist

Wall Street nearly recovered from last week's sell-off, led by AI and chip stocks AP News, with Sandisk and Lumentum spearheading the comeback Barron's. However, inflation concerns dominate: Fed's Goolsbee called the latest CPI report "borderline disturbing" CNBC, and markets anticipate further hikes after an apparent policy "mistake" Yahoo Finance. Oil declines pushed gasoline below $4 NPR. OpenAI's quarterly revenue crossed $10B TechCrunch, while Anthropic's IPO saw heavy oversubscription Quartz.

sections.title: Tech News
sections.content:
Chrome zero-day exploited in the wild

Google issued a security update for an eighth actively exploited Chrome zero-day of 2026, allowing remote code execution CyberSecurityNews. Users are urged to patch immediately; attackers are already exploiting the flaw CyberSecurityNews.

Microsoft patches 1,259 flaws

Microsoft’s November Patch Tuesday addressed 1,259 vulnerabilities, including an exploited Outlook zero-day that may expose NTLMv2 hashes The Hacker News. Security firms confirmed active exploitation of the Outlook bug The Hacker News.

AI agents backdoored via few neurons

Microsoft researchers demonstrated AI agents can be backdoored by editing fewer than 10 dormant neurons, urging model weights be scrutinized like code The Hacker News.

PlayStation cancels live-service shooter Fairgames

Sony canceled in-development live-service shooter Fairgames at Haven Studio GamesIndustry.biz. The company will pivot to a 2027 lineup of story-driven titles from internal studios GamesIndustry.biz.

sections.title: Entertainment News
sections.content:
Entertainment

Sci-fi author M. John Harrison won the Booker Prize for The End of Everything, a landmark for the genre The Guardian. Rings of Power returned with a shocking death and Sauron’s rise in its best-reviewed season yet Variety. SNL hit a two-year ratings high with host Druski Variety, while DC Studios fired James Gunn GQ.

sections.title: Sports
sections.content:
Baseball

  • Astros hire Brad Ausmus as manager ESPN — The former Yankees bench coach, who played 10 seasons in Houston, takes over the Astros’ dugout.

Basketball

  • New York Knicks 117, Milwaukee Bucks 85 ESPN — Brunson, Towns and the bench fuel a fourth straight win, dropping the Bucks to 1-10.
  • Boston Celtics 123, Philadelphia 76ers 101 ESPN — The Celtics move to 9-2 behind a balanced effort.
  • Jazz star Lauri Markkanen out at least a month with fractured hand ESPN — Salt Lake City loses its top scorer for a significant stretch.

Hockey

  • Minnesota Wild 2, Montreal Canadiens 1 (OT) ESPN — Kaprizov’s power-play goal 60 seconds into overtime lifts the Wild.
  • Colorado Avalanche 6, Toronto Maple Leafs 3 ESPN — Landeskog scores twice as Toronto drops its fourth straight.

Football

  • Western Michigan 42, Akron 14 ESPN — Buckley and Cabana power a big rushing day.

Soccer

  • Zubimendi denies wanting to leave Arsenal ESPN — The midfielder addresses Atlético rumors.

Leave out: no notable MLB on-field results; NFL playoff matchups not listed.

sections.title: Stock Analysis
sections.content:
IPOs

Recent listings on Nasdaq include Hilton Worldwide Yahoo Finance, Interpace Biosciences Yahoo Finance, Leader’s Advantage Acquisition Yahoo Finance, SPACCircle Acquisition Yahoo Finance, and Deep Sea Minerals Yahoo Finance. Upcoming: Rezera Yahoo Finance on Nov 12, Haymaker Acquisition V Yahoo Finance on Nov 9, and Live Oak VI Yahoo Finance, Modern Mining Yahoo Finance, vVARDIS Yahoo Finance, Southport II Yahoo Finance by Nov 13–16.

Major Indices

The S&P 500 rose 1.31% to 7,619.38; Nasdaq gained 1.60% Yahoo Finance. The Dow added 0.49%, Russell 2000 0.88% Yahoo Finance. VIX plunged 10.12% to 17.49 Yahoo Finance.

Sectors

Technology lagged, falling 1.15% Yahoo Finance. Communication Services led (+0.37%), followed by Financials (+0.52%) and Energy (+0.44%) Yahoo Finance.

Major Stocks

Broadcom surged 3.91% Yahoo Finance. Amazon (+1.48%) and Berkshire (+1.41%) rose Yahoo Finance. Nvidia dropped 5.47%, Microsoft 2.20%, Apple 0.62% Yahoo Finance.

Notable Movers

Nvidia’s 5.47% decline marked the largest mega-cap move; Tesla edged up 0.46%; Meta flat Yahoo Finance.

Rates & Commodities

10-year yield hit 5.00% (+0.30%) Yahoo Finance. Gold fell 1.02% to $3,989; Bitcoin slid 2.00% to $73,720 Yahoo Finance. WTI crude slipped 0.27% to $85.81 Yahoo Finance.

sections.title: Outlook
sections.content:
Next 24–48 Hours

  • Markets remain hostage to inflation data; Fed’s Goolsbee calling CPI “borderline disturbing” may fuel another sell-off.
  • Watch for Google Chrome zero-day patches—active exploitation means rapid enterprise response likely.
  • Jim Jordan’s leadership win could trigger further House GOP fallout over abuse allegations.

Next Week

  • OpenAI’s $10B quarterly revenue may accelerate AI investment flows, but Nvidia’s 5% dip signals rotation risk.
  • Israel’s Eisenkot bills could escalate domestic political confrontation with Netanyahu.
  • 10-year yield at 5.00% may pressure equities if it holds.

Next Month

  • US measles elimination status could be formally revoked absent vaccination uptick.
  • Sony’s Fairgames cancellation may prompt broader industry live-service retreat.

theme.note: Wall Street clawed back almost everything while peace stayed out of reach — the page inks that ledger line in amber and grey.
